title: DHP Benchmark: Are LLMs Good NLG Evaluators?

bias_targets.methodology: Applying hierarchical perturbations (at character, word, and sentence levels) to reference texts to create lower-quality variants, and using the Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test to measure the relative difference in LLM evaluation scores between the original and perturbed texts, thereby isolating true evaluation capability from the models' absolute scoring tendencies.
